Chromium checked the actual Django responses (400 and 200). prs.title: fix: preserve image grid pixels and symmetric padding
prs.author: YashAnand69
warnings: Curated historical excerpt: 4 of 16 fetched sources retained; other general comments/reviews and automated sources omitted. No selected body was truncated.

comments.author: Manik-Khajuria-5
comments.body: @YashAnand69 I think preserving the input dtype causes integer bool image batches to crash in Image.fromArray

comments.author: YashAnand69
comments.body: Good catch. I reproduced the Pillow crash with bool, int16, and int32 batches. The grid now retains uint8 only for uint8 inputs and uses the previous float64 path for other dtypes. I added decoded-PNG regressions for all three cases; they failed before the fix and now pass. All 94 media tests, Black 23.1, and the changed-file pre-commit hooks pass locally.

comments.author: Manik-Khajuria-5
comments.body: @YashAnand69 One issue I noticed opts.normalize=True is ignored for uint8 batches. Could you take a look at this?

comments.author: YashAnand69
comments.body: Thanks for catching this. I reproduced the uint8 `opts.normalize=True` regression, then restored the existing float-grid path when normalization is requested. The default uint8 path still preserves pixel values. Two decoded-PNG cases cover normalization with and without padding; they failed before this update. All 96 media tests, Black 23.1, and changed-file pre-commit hooks pass locally. The PR description now reflects both paths.
